countingMethod: Claims count independently reviewed related lesson claim groups, complete question groups (prompt/key/all distractors/worked reasoning) and individual glossary entries. Corrections count8 related correction groups, including dictionary coverage and one editorial grammar fix; they are not a count of individual line edits.
corrections: rs-reducers: “Each component call” incorrectly suggested per-render state ownership → each mounted component instance has independent reducer state preserved across renders; confirmed with two real mounted reducers.

rs-state-identity: prose claimed the Draft lasted until submission despite having no submit/reset action → explicitly limits the example to selected-recipient lifetime and states submission/contact is not implemented.
rs-array-updates: prose suggested a parent directly calls the component’s private addTask handler → explains a UI event handler within the component supplies the newly created record.
rs-reducers-q1: generic reducer prompt omitted its transition rules → explicitly states added adds amount and reset sets zero, preserving the existing question id and answer.

Dictionary audit: ordinary “promise persistence”, asynchronous-work and source-file phrases opened unrelated Promise/system-design/embedded senses → rephrased those boundaries and removed an accidental process-message-passing match; exact switch/throw statement aliases avoid ordinary recipient-switch language.
Glossary coverage: introduced string/array APIs and switch/throw lacked precise entries → added9 primary-sourced terms and the derived-data alias; checked all44 definitions and compiled meanings.
rs-state-snapshots: corrected “an teaching example” → “a teaching example”.

Cross-module dictionary regression: bare includes matched ordinary language such as Card includes its children, while String.includes suggested a nonexistent static method → renamed the term String.prototype.includes, kept only canonical prototype forms and a precise string-includes-method alias, and showed the real title.includes(needle) invocation in the lesson. Rechecked MDN and actual app glossary-linker behaviour using current source terms in a scratch copy; ordinary includes no longer selects the method.
boundaries: Form callback submission is taught, not persistence or a network save service.
Framework setup, routing, global state libraries and advanced reducer composition are outside the brief.
The full searchable task-list project belongs to module3.

claimGroups: Setters request another render rather than rewriting the running render binding.
JSX and handlers use the state of the render that created them.
Exact Counter click trace reports0 then1 and displays2.
Normal local assignment neither persists across calls nor requests rendering.
JavaScript closures retain lexical bindings and delayed callbacks keep earlier render values.
Recipient change does not rewrite a prior callback; controlled callback-order test confirms it.
Snapshot/order-slip mapping is limited: objects are not deeply copied and mutation can damage old snapshots.
Snapshot-based repeated value updates both request the same replacement.
Functional updaters receive the pending result and compose in order.
Mixed replacement/updater queue resolves5→6→2.
Ordinary event-handler state updates are batched after the handler code completes.
Separate intentional clicks are handled separately.
Pure updaters must avoid input mutation and external writes.
Development StrictMode can repeat updater evaluation and ignore a result; no logic relies on call counts.
Event-specific external work belongs in the event handler; ordered-instructions analogy accurately limits queue modelling.
Objects in state are ordinary reference values treated as immutable.
Object.is same reference can let React skip an update even after unsafe field mutation.
Object spread copies own enumerable properties and stays shallow.
Later object-literal properties override earlier spread values.
Nested updates copy each object on the changed path, without cloning untouched branches.
Parentheses after an arrow permit an implicitly returned object literal.
Exact profile update creates both new containers, preserves name/postcode and leaves old city unchanged.
Exact intentional mutation damages the old shared address before outer copying; folder/page analogy mapping and limits agree.
Array spread creates a new array with the original element references.
filter returns selected elements and map transforms elements without inherent source mutation.
Stable record ids represent identity while array indexes represent position.
Exact handlers add/remove/finish tasks with ordered functional updates.
finishTask replaces the array and matching item while reusing the unchanged item.
Exact shallow-copy counterexample mutates an item still shared by the old array.
push/splice/sort/reverse mutate their receiver arrays.
Sorting a fresh copy preserves old order when the comparison callback is pure; guest-list/contact-card analogy matches shared references.
Controlled text uses string value and event.target.value.
Controlled checkbox uses boolean checked and event.target.checked rather than value.
Uncontrolled defaults seed the input rather than continuously control user-edited current values.
Exact TaskForm has associated visible labels for both controls.
Exact text/checkbox edits submit the stated title/done object through onSave.
onSubmit handles form submission and explicit submit controls; local buttons need type=button.
preventDefault cancels normal form navigation without itself stopping propagation.
Controlled text should stay string-valued rather than switch from undefined/null.
onChange must update controlling state synchronously; an unchanged fixed value prevents accepted edits.
htmlFor/id supplies separate label association; placeholder does not substitute for visible label; callback save does not implement persistence.
Separate local useState values do not automatically share data.
Lifting places the shared owner at the nearest useful common parent.
Props send current data down and callback props request changes without child mutation.
Exact two-editor source propagates edits and clearing in both directions through one parent value.
Controlled custom component is a design relationship and can retain unrelated local state.
Independent details can remain local rather than all moving to the root.
Initial prop-derived state is not automatically overwritten by later props; thermostat/displays analogy maps the shared owner accurately.
Values determined by current props/state should usually be calculated during render rather than duplicated.
Stored filtered results can become inconsistent if only query changes refresh them.
Exact search uses lower-case string conversion and case-sensitive includes on both transformed inputs.
Exact result and count recalculate for query, changed tasks and deletion without mutating source data.
One status value avoids simultaneous mutually exclusive mode flags.
Busy derives from submitting; status representation itself implements no asynchronous submission operation.
Selected-id lookup avoids duplicated task objects and must handle absent ids; calculated-bill analogy excludes independent historical records.
React associates state with rendered-tree identity, including component type/position/key.
Fresh JSX expressions and cosmetic props alone do not necessarily reset state.
Removal, changed type or changed key discards old local state.
Exact Draft keeps text across same-key name updates.
Exact key7→key8→key7 sequence creates empty new instances and does not archive removed drafts.
Keys distinguish siblings rather than globally cache state.
Stable data keys follow reordered rows; index keys can misassociate state and random keys recreate instances.
Nested definitions create a different function type on parent renders and can reset state; cubby analogy expressly limits discarded-state recovery.
A reducer calculates next state from state/action and centralises update rules.
Action shape is a convention; type string plus minimal event information is common.
useReducer is an alternative local-state Hook, not an automatic global store; mounted instances remain independent.
Exact switch/return/throw reducer adds amounts, resets count, preserves other fields and rejects unknown actions.
Reducers must be pure and must not mutate inputs, request external work or generate event identifiers unpredictably.
Create event id/time data in the handler and include it in actions.
useReducer returns current state and dispatch and belongs at the top level.
Exact UI trace adds2, adds2, resets0; dispatch does not rewrite the running render snapshot.
Development StrictMode can repeat reducer checks and ignore a result; scorekeeper analogy keeps display updates and external work outside the reducer.

execution.method: React19.3.1 plus matching React DOM; Babel automatic JSX runtime; jsdom mounted DOM with actual input/change/click/submit interactions. Tests observe committed behaviours and do not assert exact render/updater call counts.

formulaReview.reason: All3 lint hits are genuine executable JSX props inside source fences, so they are Rule6 code exceptions, not mathematical equations.

includesFollowup.primaryPassages: MDN heading identifies String.prototype.includes; its description confirms case-sensitive instance matching and the empty-string result.

rs-state-snapshots.rationale: Printed order slip distinguishes the current render snapshot from later state; the limit correctly states closures capture bindings and nested objects are not deeply copied.

rs-queued-updates.rationale: Ordered clerk instructions correctly map replacement and updater queue entries; the limit distinguishes the simple trace from repeatable development checks.

rs-object-updates.rationale: Folder and address page accurately separate the outer object from the shared nested reference and explain copying both changed levels without a deep clone.

rs-array-updates.rationale: Guest list and contact cards explain why copying an array still shares item objects; the limit correctly permits sharing unchanged read-only records.

rs-controlled-inputs.rationale: No analogy is needed: the complete labelled form and explicit value/checked/default/submit rules give a direct procedure; another comparison would obscure exact DOM event semantics.

rs-lift-state.rationale: Two displays on one thermostat map children to views and the parent to the single owner; the limit correctly keeps independent settings local.

rs-state-shape.rationale: Bill line items and calculated totals explain derivation versus duplicated state; the historical-record limit prevents incorrectly deriving genuinely independent information. Re-reviewed after the method-name prose correction: the bill/input/derived-value mapping and historical-record limit remain accurate, and no required fact moved into the disclosure.

rs-state-identity.rationale: Labelled cubby maps identity and resetting for a new entity; the limit explicitly denies global key scope or cached removed state.

rs-reducers.rationale: Score and event-card rulebook map current state/action/reducer; the limit correctly keeps dispatch/display/external work separate from pure calculation.
